f3_program: collection("car_buyers", "person", "car_purchase", source("A group of six friends planned to buy a car"))
observe(at("car_buyers.count", "initial"), 6, "count", source("A group of six friends"))
observe(at("car_purchase.cost", "initial"), 1700, "dollar", source("The cost of the car is $1700"))
observe(at("car_wash.funds_earned", "current"), 500, "dollar", source("At the car wash, they earn $500"))
remove("apply_car_wash_funds", "car_buyers", at("car_purchase.cost", "current"), at("car_wash.funds_earned", "current"), source("which would be taken out of the total cost"))

quotient_relation(at("car_purchase.per_friend_payment", "before_brad_withdrawal"), at("car_purchase.cost", "current"), at("car_buyers.count", "initial"), source("The remaining cost would be split between the six friends"))
remove("brad_withdrawal", "brad", at("car_buyers.count", "current"), 1, source("Brad decided not to join in the purchase of the car"))
quotient_relation(at("car_purchase.per_friend_payment", "now"), at("car_purchase.cost", "current"), at("car_buyers.count", "current"), source("they plan to share the cost equally"))
query("difference", at("car_purchase.per_friend_payment", "before_brad_withdrawal"), at("car_purchase.per_friend_payment", "now"))
observe(at("road.unpaved_length", "initial"), 16, "mile", source("a newly constructed 16-mile road"))
observe(at("asphalt.gravel_bags_per_truckload", "current"), 2, "bag/truckload", source("Each truckloads of asphalt uses two bags of gravel"))
multiple(at("asphalt.gravel_bags_per_truckload", "current"), at("asphalt.pitch_barrels_per_truckload", "current"), 5, source("five times as many bags of gravel as it does barrels of pitch"))
observe(at("road_paving.asphalt_truckloads_per_mile", "current"), 3, "truckload/mile", source("It takes three truckloads of asphalt to pave each mile of road"))
remove("pave_day_1", "roadwork_company", at("road.unpaved_length", "current"), 4, source("The company paved 4 miles of road on one day"))
offset(at("road.paved_length", "day_2"), scale(event_field("pave_day_1", "quantity"), 2), -1, "mile", source("one mile less than double that on the second day"))
remove("pave_day_2", "roadwork_company", at("road.unpaved_length", "current"), at("road.paved_length", "day_2"), source("then one mile less than double that on the second day"))

rate_relation(at("roadwork_company.asphalt_truckloads.required", "day_3"), at("road_paving.asphalt_truckloads_per_mile", "current"), at("road.unpaved_length", "current"), source("It takes three truckloads of asphalt to pave each mile of road"))

rate_relation(at("roadwork_company.pitch_barrels.required", "day_3"), at("asphalt.pitch_barrels_per_truckload", "current"), at("roadwork_company.asphalt_truckloads.required", "day_3"), source("Each truckloads of asphalt uses two bags of gravel and five times as many bags of gravel as it does barrels of pitch to make"))
query("value", at("roadwork_company.pitch_barrels.required", "day_3"))
collection("cd_store.cds", "cd", "cd_store", source("the total number of CDs was 200"))
observe(at("cd_store.cds.count", "initial"), 200, "count", source("the total number of CDs was 200"))
percent_of(at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.count", "initial"), at("cd_store.cds.count", "initial"), 40, source("40% of the CDs cost $10 each"))

sum_relation(at("cd_store.cds.count", "initial"), at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.count", "initial"), at("cd_store.cds.five_dollar.count", "initial"), source("40% of the CDs cost $10 each, and the rest cost $5 each"))
observe(at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.unit_price", "current"), 10, "dollar/cd", source("$10 each"))
observe(at("cd_store.cds.five_dollar.unit_price", "current"), 5, "dollar/cd", source("$5 each"))
collection("prince.purchased_cds", "cd", "prince", source("Prince bought half the CDs sold at $10 each, and all of the CDs sold at $5 each"))

transfer("prince_buys_ten_dollar_cds", "prince", at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.count", "current"), at("prince.purchased_cds.ten_dollar.count", "current"), fraction(at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("Prince bought half the CDs sold at $10 each"))

transfer("prince_buys_five_dollar_cds", "prince", at("cd_store.cds.five_dollar.count", "current"), at("prince.purchased_cds.five_dollar.count", "current"), at("cd_store.cds.five_dollar.count", "initial"), source("all of the CDs sold at $5 each"))
collection("prince.cd_purchase_costs", "purchase_cost", "prince", source("Prince bought half the CDs sold at $10 each, and all of the CDs sold at $5 each"))
member("prince.cd_purchase_costs", "prince.cd_purchase_costs.ten_dollar_cds", source("half the CDs sold at $10 each"))
member("prince.cd_purchase_costs", "prince.cd_purchase_costs.five_dollar_cds", source("all of the CDs sold at $5 each"))

rate_relation(at("prince.cd_purchase_costs.ten_dollar_cds", "current"), at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.unit_price", "current"), event_field("prince_buys_ten_dollar_cds", "quantity"), source("Prince bought half the CDs sold at $10 each"))

rate_relation(at("prince.cd_purchase_costs.five_dollar_cds", "current"), at("cd_store.cds.five_dollar.unit_price", "current"), event_field("prince_buys_five_dollar_cds", "quantity"), source("all of the CDs sold at $5 each"))
query("sum", "prince.cd_purchase_costs", "current")
observe(at("mrs_lim.milking.frequency", "current"), 2, "times/day", source("twice a day"))
produce("yesterday_morning_milking", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.volume", "current"), 68, source("Yesterday morning, she got 68 gallons of milk"))
produce("yesterday_evening_milking", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.volume", "current"), 82, source("in the evening, she got 82 gallons"))

offset(at("mrs_lim.milk.produced", "this_morning"), event_field("yesterday_morning_milking", "quantity"), -18, "gallon", source("This morning, she got 18 gallons fewer than she had yesterday morning"))

produce("this_morning_milking", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.volume", "current"), at("mrs_lim.milk.produced", "this_morning"), source("This morning, she got 18 gallons fewer than she had yesterday morning"))
remove("afternoon_sale", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.volume", "current"), "mrs_lim.milk.afternoon_sold.volume", source("selling some gallons of milk in the afternoon"))
observe(at("mrs_lim.milk.volume", "now"), 24, "gallon", source("Mrs. Lim has only 24 gallons left"))
observe(at("mrs_lim.milk.price_per_gallon", "current"), 3.5, "dollar/gallon", source("each gallon costs $3.50"))

rate_relation(at("mrs_lim.milk_sales.revenue", "afternoon"), at("mrs_lim.milk.price_per_gallon", "current"), event_field("afternoon_sale", "quantity"), source("How much was her revenue for the milk if each gallon costs $3.50"))
query("value", at("mrs_lim.milk_sales.revenue", "afternoon"))
collection("sam.marbles", "marble", "sam", source("Sam has twice as many marbles as Steve"))
collection("steve.marbles", "marble", "steve", source("Sam has twice as many marbles as Steve"))
collection("sally.marbles", "marble", "sally", source("Sally has 5 less than Sam"))
multiple(at("sam.marbles.count", "initial"), at("steve.marbles.count", "initial"), 2, source("Sam has twice as many marbles as Steve"))
offset(at("sally.marbles.count", "initial"), at("sam.marbles.count", "initial"), -5, "count", source("Sally has 5 less than Sam"))
transfer("sam_to_sally", "sam", at("sam.marbles.count", "current"), at("sally.marbles.count", "current"), 3, source("Sam has given Sally and Steve 3 marbles each"))
transfer("sam_to_steve", "sam", at("sam.marbles.count", "current"), at("steve.marbles.count", "current"), 3, source("Sam has given Sally and Steve 3 marbles each"))
observe(at("sam.marbles.count", "now"), 8, "count", source("Sam has 8 marbles left"))
query("value", at("steve.marbles.count", "now"))
